rules.title: Provide lockable-open disconnecting means where disconnect is out of sight
rules.intent: Ensure a disconnecting means that is not within sight of the equipment it controls cannot be inadvertently re-energized while the equipment is being serviced.
evidence_required: Panel schedule or one-line diagram identifying the disconnecting means location relative to served equipment
Cut sheet or listing label for the lockable disconnect device or breaker lock-off accessory
Floor plan showing sight-line distance between disconnect and equipment

rules.title: Do not use grounded-conductor identification colors for luminaire control conductors
rules.intent: Prevent misidentification of an energized control conductor as the grounded (neutral) branch-circuit conductor identified per 200.6.
evidence_required: Luminaire wiring diagram showing control conductor color coding
Specification section for conductor identification/color schedule
Fixture schedule noting 0-10V or other control wiring within luminaires

rules.title: Size household range and cooking appliance branch circuits per 210.19(A)(3) and Table 220.55
rules.intent: Allow demand-factored conductor sizing for household cooking equipment while keeping conductors adequate for the load.
evidence_required: Range/cooking appliance nameplate kW rating on plans or appliance schedule
Table 220.55 demand calculation for the cooking load
Panel schedule showing branch-circuit conductor size and breaker rating

rules.title: Determine multi-load branch circuit ratings per 210.23
rules.intent: Ensure branch circuits shared by appliances and other loads are rated per the permissible-load rules of 210.23.
evidence_required: Panel schedule showing all loads on the shared branch circuit
Load calculation demonstrating compliance with 210.23 load limits
Appliance schedule with nameplate ratings

rules.title: Provide compliant supplementary overcurrent devices for subdivided heating loads
rules.intent: Ensure supplementary overcurrent devices protecting subdivided resistance heating loads are factory-provided, accessible, and suitable for branch-circuit protection.
evidence_required: Heater manufacturer cut sheet showing factory-installed supplementary overcurrent devices
Equipment listing label or documentation showing devices suitable for branch-circuit protection
Installation drawing showing accessibility of the supplementary devices

rules.title: Protect appliance and heater branch circuits per 240.4 conductor protection
rules.intent: Ensure branch-circuit conductors serving appliances and heating equipment are protected against overcurrent in accordance with their ampacity.
evidence_required: Panel schedule with breaker/fuse ratings versus conductor sizes
Conductor ampacity calculation or schedule
Feeder/branch one-line diagram

rules.title: Permit single disconnecting means for cartridge-fused subdivided boiler circuits
rules.intent: Allow one disconnecting means to serve several subdivided boiler heating circuits protected by cartridge fuses, consistent with the fuse disconnect rules of 240.40.
evidence_required: Boiler wiring diagram showing cartridge fuse blocks and disconnect arrangement
Equipment cut sheet showing the single disconnecting means ahead of the fuses

rules.title: Ground central vacuum assembly metal parts per 250.110
rules.intent: Ensure exposed metal parts of central vacuum outlet assemblies likely to become energized are connected to an equipment grounding conductor.
evidence_required: Central vacuum outlet assembly listing/cut sheet
Wiring detail showing equipment grounding conductor connection
Branch-circuit schedule for the vacuum assembly circuit

rules.title: Keep equipment-grounding-conductor colors off luminaire control conductors
rules.intent: Prevent a luminaire control conductor from being mistaken for the equipment grounding conductor identified per 250.119.
evidence_required: Luminaire/control wiring diagram with conductor color schedule
Specification for conductor identification
Field re-identification detail where gray control conductors are used

rules.title: Control over-1000V electric-discharge luminaires with a switch opening all ungrounded primary conductors
rules.intent: Ensure high-voltage electric-discharge lighting can be fully de-energized on the primary side by an externally operable device.
evidence_required: Lighting one-line diagram showing the primary-side switch or circuit breaker
Fixture schedule identifying over-1000V electric-discharge equipment
Switch/breaker cut sheet showing all ungrounded poles switched

rules.title: Locate the high-voltage lighting control switch within sight or make it lockable open
rules.intent: Guarantee servicing personnel can verify or secure the de-energized state of over-1000V lighting equipment.
evidence_required: Reflected ceiling plan or site plan showing switch location relative to luminaires
Lock-off provision cut sheet if switch is remote

rules.title: Identify luminaire control conductor insulation distinctly from grounded and grounding conductors
rules.intent: Prevent shock and miswiring hazards when control conductors share a luminaire or enclosure with branch-circuit conductors.
evidence_required: Luminaire wiring diagram showing control (e.g., 0-10V dimming) conductor colors
Conductor identification specification
Fixture schedule identifying luminaires with field-connected control conductors

rules.title: Size individual appliance branch-circuit conductors to the marked rating (125% if continuous)
rules.intent: Ensure branch circuits can carry appliance current without overheating.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate ratings on appliance schedule
Branch-circuit conductor size and ampacity on panel schedule
Continuous-load determination and 125% sizing calculation

rules.title: Rate shared appliance branch circuits per 210.23
rules.intent: Prevent overload of branch circuits that supply an appliance together with other loads.
evidence_required: Panel schedule listing all loads on the circuit
210.23 permissible-load check calculation

rules.title: Do not exceed the appliance-marked overcurrent device rating
rules.intent: Protect appliance internal wiring by honoring the manufacturer's marked maximum protective device rating.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate photo or cut sheet showing maximum overcurrent protective device rating
Panel schedule showing installed breaker/fuse rating

rules.title: Cap heating-appliance circuits at 50 A (subdivide household surface-element loads over 60 A demand)
rules.intent: Limit fault energy and overload exposure on high-demand heating appliance circuits.
evidence_required: Table 220.55 demand calculation for the appliance
Panel schedule showing subdivided circuits and breaker ratings not over 50 A
Appliance cut sheet identifying element type and configuration

rules.title: Limit overcurrent protection for a single non-motor-operated appliance
rules.intent: Match the overcurrent device to the appliance rating when no protective device rating is marked.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate current rating
Panel schedule showing breaker/fuse rating on the individual circuit
150% sizing calculation where applicable

rules.title: Subdivide resistance heating elements over 48 A and protect each subdivision at 60 A max
rules.intent: Keep resistance-element circuit sizes within safe overcurrent-protection limits.
evidence_required: Appliance internal wiring diagram showing element subdivision
Supplementary overcurrent device ratings on manufacturer cut sheet
ASME stamp documentation or listing where the 120 A/150 A alternative is used

rules.title: Size storage water heater (120 gal or less) circuit at 125% of heater rating
rules.intent: Treat fixed storage water heaters as continuous loads so conductors and overcurrent devices do not run at full rating.
evidence_required: Water heater nameplate rating (kW/amperes) and tank capacity
Panel schedule showing conductor size and breaker rating
125% sizing calculation

rules.title: Connect central vacuum outlet assemblies with adequate conductors and grounding
rules.intent: Ensure listed central vacuum assemblies are supplied per 210.23(A), with connecting conductors at least as large as the branch-circuit conductors and metal parts grounded.
evidence_required: Central vacuum assembly listing documentation
Conductor sizes for connecting and branch-circuit conductors
Grounding connection detail

rules.title: Apply Article 430 to motor-operated appliances and Article 440 to hermetic-compressor appliances
rules.intent: Route motor and refrigerant-compressor appliances to the motor and HVAC-equipment rules except where Article 422 amends them.
evidence_required: Appliance schedule identifying motor-operated and compressor-bearing appliances
Motor circuit sizing per Article 430 shown on plans

rules.title: Provide electric-readiness circuits in single-family dwellings (heat pump water heater, cooktop, dryer)
rules.intent: Implement California Energy Code electrification-readiness requirements for one- and two-dwelling residential buildings.
evidence_required: Panel schedule showing dedicated/reserved circuits with required identifications
Floor plan showing designated heat pump water heater space and receptacle
Title 24 Part 6 (Energy Code) compliance forms referencing 150.0(n), 150.0(u), 150.0(v)

rules.title: Provide electric-readiness circuits in multifamily dwelling units (cooktop, dryer)
rules.intent: Implement California Energy Code electrification-readiness requirements for multifamily buildings.
evidence_required: Unit panel schedules showing dedicated circuits and identifications
Title 24 Part 6 (Energy Code) compliance forms referencing 160.9(b) and 160.9(c)

rules.title: Provide a simultaneous all-ungrounded-conductor disconnect for each appliance
rules.intent: Guarantee every appliance can be fully isolated from its supply for service and safety.
evidence_required: One-line diagram or panel schedule identifying each appliance disconnecting means
Detail showing grouping and identification labels where multiple sources supply one appliance

rules.title: Use branch-circuit device as disconnect for permanently connected appliances only if within sight or lockable
rules.intent: Allow the branch-circuit overcurrent device or switch to serve as the appliance disconnect while preserving servicing safety.
evidence_required: Panel schedule identifying the branch-circuit device serving as disconnect
Plan showing device location within sight of the appliance or lock-off accessory cut sheet
Appliance nameplate volt-ampere rating

rules.title: Locate the disconnect within sight (or lockable) for motor-operated appliances over 1/8 hp
rules.intent: Protect personnel servicing motor-operated appliances by keeping the disconnect visible or locked open, per motor disconnect rules.
evidence_required: Appliance motor horsepower rating from nameplate or cut sheet
Plan showing disconnect location relative to appliance
Disconnect device rating documentation per 430.109/430.110

rules.title: Use an accessible plug-and-receptacle as the disconnect for cord-and-plug appliances, rated for the appliance
rules.intent: Permit the attachment plug or separable connector to serve as the appliance disconnect when it is accessible and adequately rated.
evidence_required: Receptacle rating on plans versus appliance nameplate rating
Plan detail showing receptacle accessibility (e.g., range rear-base connection accessible by drawer removal)
Appliance cord-and-plug configuration cut sheet

rules.title: Accept a marked-off unit switch as the appliance disconnect only with an occupancy-appropriate backup disconnect
rules.intent: Allow integral appliance unit switches to serve as the disconnect while ensuring a second means of disconnection exists per occupancy type.
evidence_required: Appliance cut sheet showing unit switch with marked-off position
Plan identifying the other disconnecting means and its location per occupancy type
Occupancy classification on drawings

rules.title: Equip water heaters with a supplemental temperature-limiting disconnect and T&P relief marking
rules.intent: Prevent scald and explosion hazards by requiring an over-temperature cutout in addition to the operating thermostat.
evidence_required: Water heater listing/cut sheet showing high-limit (energy cutoff) device
Nameplate marking requiring temperature and pressure relief valve
Plumbing plan showing T&P relief valve installation

rules.title: Provide a visible appliance nameplate with identifying name and electrical rating
rules.intent: Enable plan check and field verification of circuit sizing against manufacturer ratings.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate data on appliance schedule or submittal
Installation detail showing nameplate visibility/accessibility

rules.title: Mark combined motor-and-load appliances with equivalent horsepower and circuit sizing data
rules.intent: Ensure appliances consisting of motors and other loads carry the ratings needed to select supply conductors and overcurrent protection.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate/submittal showing minimum circuit ampacity (MCA) and maximum overcurrent protection (MOP)
Motor nameplate horsepower documentation
Panel schedule showing circuit sized to marked MCA/MOP

rules.title: Provide a 125%-rated, lockable, simultaneous disconnect for fixed electric space-heating equipment
rules.intent: Allow safe servicing of heaters, motor controllers, and supplementary overcurrent devices by fully isolating all ungrounded conductors.
evidence_required: Heater and motor load schedule with 125% disconnect sizing calculation
Disconnect cut sheet showing ampere rating and lock-open provision
Plan showing disconnect location relative to heater/controller and supplementary overcurrent devices

rules.title: Protect space-heating resistance elements at 60 A max and subdivide loads over 48 A
rules.intent: Limit each resistance heating element circuit to a safe overcurrent level.
evidence_required: Heater cut sheet showing element subdivision and supplementary device ratings
Nameplate amperes versus 48 A subdivision check
Supplementary overcurrent device schedule

rules.title: Size field-wired subdivided-load conductors at 125% and protect them per 240.4
rules.intent: Keep field conductors between the heater and its supplementary overcurrent devices from operating above safe loading.
evidence_required: Conductor sizing calculation at 125% of subdivided load
Heater marking of minimum conductor size where 100% alternative used
Wiring diagram of field conductors and supplementary devices

rules.title: Apply Article 440 to space-heating equipment with hermetic refrigerant motor-compressors
rules.intent: Route heat-pump style space-heating equipment to the refrigerant-compressor equipment rules in addition to Article 424.
evidence_required: Equipment schedule identifying compressor-bearing heating equipment
Nameplate MCA/MOP data per Article 440 marking

rules.title: Limit multi-outlet space-heating branch circuits to 30 A (50 A infrared in non-dwellings)
rules.intent: Cap the rating of branch circuits serving multiple fixed space-heating outlets.
evidence_required: Panel schedule showing heating circuit ratings and outlet counts
Plan identifying infrared heating equipment and occupancy type

rules.title: Size space-heating branch-circuit conductors at 125% of the load
rules.intent: Treat fixed electric space heating and associated motors as continuous loads for conductor sizing.
evidence_required: Heating load schedule with 125% conductor sizing calculation
Panel schedule showing conductor sizes for heating circuits

rules.title: Protect resistance-type boiler elements at 150 A/120 A (ASME vessel) or 60 A/48 A (non-ASME)
rules.intent: Bound the overcurrent protection and load subdivision of resistance-type space-heating boilers based on vessel construction.
evidence_required: Boiler cut sheet with ASME stamp documentation where the 150 A/120 A limits are used
Element subdivision and supplementary overcurrent device schedule
Boiler nameplate ampere rating

rules.title: Size electrode boiler branch-circuit conductors and overcurrent devices at 125% of total load
rules.intent: Ensure electrode-type space-heating boiler circuits are sized as continuous loads.
evidence_required: Electrode boiler nameplate rating and 125% sizing calculation
Panel schedule showing conductor and overcurrent device sizes
Contactor/relay 100%-continuous listing documentation where used

rules.title: Provide a 125%-rated, lockable, simultaneous disconnect for fixed industrial process heating equipment
rules.intent: Allow safe servicing of industrial process heaters by fully isolating heaters, controllers, and supplementary overcurrent devices.
evidence_required: Process heater load schedule with 125% disconnect sizing calculation
Disconnect cut sheet showing lock-open capability
Plan showing disconnect location relative to heater, controller, and supplementary devices

rules.title: Apply Articles 440 and 430 to industrial process heating equipment with compressors or motors
rules.intent: Route compressor- and motor-bearing industrial process heating equipment to the applicable motor and refrigeration equipment rules.
evidence_required: Equipment schedule identifying motors and compressors within process heating equipment
Motor/compressor circuit sizing documentation per Articles 430/440

rules.title: Protect industrial process resistance elements at 60 A/48 A (or 150 A/120 A where enclosed or ASME) and size subdivided-load conductors at 125%
rules.intent: Bound overcurrent protection and conductor sizing for resistance-type industrial process heating elements.
evidence_required: Process heater cut sheet showing element subdivision and device ratings
ASME stamp or enclosure identification where the 120 A/150 A alternative is used
Field conductor sizing calculation at 125%

rules.title: Protect industrial process boiler elements at 150 A/120 A (ASME vessel) or 60 A/48 A (non-ASME)
rules.intent: Bound overcurrent protection and load subdivision for resistance-type industrial process boilers based on vessel construction.
evidence_required: Boiler ASME stamp documentation where 150 A/120 A limits are used
Element subdivision and supplementary device schedule
Boiler nameplate ampere rating

rules.title: Size industrial electrode boiler conductors and overcurrent devices at 125% of total load
rules.intent: Ensure industrial process electrode boiler circuits are sized as continuous loads.
evidence_required: Electrode boiler nameplate rating and 125% sizing calculation
Panel schedule showing conductor and overcurrent device sizes
Contactor/relay 100%-continuous listing documentation where used

rules.title: Use a 430.109-compliant disconnect type for motor-operated appliances over 1/8 hp
rules.intent: Ensure the disconnecting means for motor-operated appliances is of a type recognized for motor circuits.
evidence_required: Disconnect device cut sheet showing horsepower rating or other 430.109-recognized type
Appliance motor nameplate horsepower

rules.title: Rate motor-appliance disconnects and combined-load equivalence per 430.110
rules.intent: Ensure appliance disconnect ampere ratings and combined motor-plus-load horsepower equivalence follow the motor-circuit sizing rules.
evidence_required: Disconnect ampere/horsepower rating documentation
Equivalent horsepower calculation for combined loads
Appliance nameplate data

rules.title: Mark motor-operated appliances with 430.7 data where separate overcurrent devices are required
rules.intent: Give installers and plan checkers the motor data needed to select separate overload/overcurrent devices.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate showing motor data per 430.7
Overload/overcurrent device selection documentation matching marked data

rules.title: Protect hermetic compressor appliances per Article 440 and mark selection data per 440.4
rules.intent: Ensure hermetic refrigerant motor-compressors in appliances have proper overload protection and marking for device selection.
evidence_required: Appliance nameplate showing rated-load current and branch-circuit selection current per 440.4
Overload protection documentation for the compressor
Panel schedule showing circuit sized to nameplate data

rules.title: Size irrigation machine branch-circuit conductors to the equivalent continuous-current rating
rules.intent: Ensure branch-circuit conductors for electrically driven or controlled irrigation machines carry the duty-cycle-adjusted continuous load.
evidence_required: Irrigation machine motor schedule with nameplate full-load currents
Equivalent continuous-current calculation per 675.7(A) or 675.22(A)
Conductor size and ampacity on circuit schedule or one-line diagram
